`CALCULATE` evaluates an expression (usually a measure) in a **modified filter context**. It is the main way DAX changes which rows a calculation sees.

```
CALCULATE( <expression>, <filter1>, <filter2>, ... )
```

**Filter context.** Every DAX measure is computed inside a filter context: the set of filters from slicers, rows and columns of a visual, and page filters. The same measure `[Total Sales]` gives a different number in each cell of a matrix because each cell has different filters.

**What CALCULATE does.**
1. It takes the current filter context.
2. It applies your filter arguments on
